arguments.command:
python3 - << 'EOF'
# Data from table (in millions of dollars)
china_2000 = 16531
china_2002 = 15483
taiwan_2000 = 17374
taiwan_2002 = 18708

# Calculate absolute differences for each year
diff_2000 = abs(china_2000 - taiwan_2000)

# Calculate change in absolute difference

print(f"2002: China={china_2002}, Taiwan={taiwan_2002}, |diff|={diff_2002}")
print(f"Change in absolute difference from 2000 to 2002: {change}")
EOF
